summary: Restore ḥat, the imperative meaning put
rationale: The corpus reads mofeqa, ḥat i manṯo b qḏola w ḥnaqa: take it out, put the hair around its neck, and strangle it. The entry substitutes plain h in hat and places a comma between the verb and its object. The consonant distinction h/ḥ is not a normalization convention.

summary: Move the active Preterit-wa example out of the detransitive box
rationale: Ḥnǝ́q-way-le-lux contains the active preterit L-ending -le and the second-person object -lux. The edition confirms the active meaning die Zinsen haben dich erwürgt. Compare active ḥnəqle in ḥnq.I.t.preterit.1 with detransitive ḥniq in ḥnq.I.d.preterit.2. File this example in a non-detransitive Preterit-wa box, creating that box if needed.
